symptom: XeLaTeX halted because the bounded French build preamble does not define a proof environment.
cause: I introduced a proof wrapper not used elsewhere in the diplomatic French source instead of retaining the source's plain enumerated proof structure.
detection: The first serialized XeLaTeX pass failed immediately at the newly introduced begin proof line before the generation was admitted.
repair: Removed only the unsupported begin/end proof wrapper in the no-overwrite source generation; retained every source word, formula, item label, and order unchanged. The successor R57 build converged in three passes.
